ranked.headline: Computational fusion of histology and spatial data corrects tissue transcriptomic readouts
ranked.summary: Early 2026 preprints and publications apply deep learning to fuse histology, spatial and single-cell transcriptomics for tissue reconstruction.

ranked.headline: Learned models supply regulatory context absent from raw sequence inputs
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers build multimodal and graph-structured inputs to address generalization limits rather than extending sequence length.

ranked.headline: Generative models are tested on latent variability, noise and sparse biological data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications benchmark variational, foundation-model and Bayesian approaches against established methods on omics and genomic data.

ranked.headline: Closed-loop and flow-inertia models link mechanism to measurable dynamics across scales
ranked.summary: Analytical and multi-level frameworks now aim to make mechanism-dynamics coupling interpretable across biological scales, from actin to crop growth.

ranked.headline: Machine learning and docking predict molecular binding across GPCRs, PPIs and screening
ranked.summary: Sequence-based affinity models, GPU virtual screening and generative design are being checked against benchmarks or experimental readouts.

ranked.headline: Reaction networks predict gene expression in CRISPRa, riboswitches and cell-free systems
ranked.summary: Recent papers pair explicit reaction-network models with experimental design for CRISPRa, riboswitch engineering and cell-free expression.

ranked.headline: Generative models adapted to single-cell and spatial omics noise and multimodal fusion
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend generative and latent-variable models to perturbation responses, million-cell datasets, and multimodal fusion tests.

ranked.headline: Graph and deep models predict drug, microbiome, and cancer subtype outcomes
ranked.summary: Foundation and graph models now target drug response, perturbation, and multi-omics outcomes, often with small-sample or uncertainty-aware designs.

ranked.headline: Computational models infer gene regulation and genome architecture from single-cell data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a 27,000-submission competition benchmark evaluate deep and graph models for regulatory inference from single-cell data.

ranked.headline: Inferring directed and time-resolved network structure from proteomic measurements
ranked.summary: Recent proteomic studies pair benchmarked or probabilistic inference with directional and time-resolved network structure.

ranked.headline: Machine learning models for spectral annotation, reaction prediction, and benchmarking
ranked.summary: Standardized benchmarks and transformer-based annotation methods are emerging to assess computational small-molecule prediction.

ranked.headline: Read-level taxon and locus assignment in mixed and complex sequencing samples
ranked.summary: Mixed and complex samples call for read-level taxonomic and locus assignment across amplicon, metatranscriptomic, and genome-wide data.

ranked.headline: Protein language model and structure-based learning for peptide prediction and design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers add explicit latent organization for controlled peptide design and learned use of structural geometry as model input.

ranked.headline: Scored proteome-scale frameworks map organelle, complex, and secretome architecture
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and an archaeal defense-system study apply quantified, genome-scale frameworks to proteome and pangenome evolution.

ranked.headline: Sequence-based models predict enzyme function, splice sites, and variant pathogenicity
ranked.summary: Limited labels and unseen label spaces motivate data-efficient sequence models across enzymes, splicing, and variants.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking ensemble models of flexible proteins against experimental data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test ensemble generation and cryo-EM refinement against experimental density, SAXS and fibril structures for flexible proteins.

ranked.headline: Phylogenetic and batch structure built directly into omics inference models
ranked.summary: Sparse, heterogeneous, and indirectly observed omics data demand inference models that encode batch and phylogenetic structure directly.

ranked.headline: Pangenome graphs link structural and transposable element variants to traits
ranked.summary: Long-read pangenome graphs now resolve structural and transposable element variation well enough to associate it with traits and adaptation.

ranked.headline: Synaptic tuning and energetics bound decodability and collective coding dynamics
ranked.summary: Synaptic tuning, energetic cost, and connection-type rules are being analyzed as direct limits on decodable information and network dynamics.

ranked.headline: Methods for ancestry, GxE testing, and simulation extend population genomic inference
ranked.summary: Recent work refines how genetic ancestry, gene-environment loci, and low-coverage sequencing data are modeled from population-scale resources.

ranked.headline: Experimental data arbitrate accuracy of computational RNA and conformational models
ranked.summary: Recent work benchmarks RNA structure prediction, ML potentials, and trajectory analysis against experimental or reference data.

ranked.headline: Learned models condition on target properties to design delivery vehicles
ranked.summary: Recent items pair learned models with AAV capsid, lipid nanoparticle, and drug concentration-time tasks, each evaluated on its own endpoints.

ranked.headline: Reusable omics software for cross-platform conversion, meta-analysis and biomarker plots
ranked.summary: Accessible, reusable implementations now package cross-platform conversion, meta-analysis and biomarker exploration as interactive or scriptable tools.

ranked.headline: Co-folding models probed for allosteric binding failures and mutation invariance
ranked.summary: Structure predictors and affinity models are being stress-tested on allosteric ligands, disordered regions, and adversarial sequence edits.

ranked.headline: Computational pipelines widen peptide and proteoform identification from MS data
ranked.summary: TopRepo's 12 million top-down spectra, benchmarked DIA workflows, and iPepGen's immunopeptidogenomics pipeline expand peptide-level evidence from MS data.

ranked.headline: Alignment-free k-mer features separate Delta spike sequences and HIV-1 DNA from RNA
ranked.summary: Reference-free k-mer models now recover variant- and class-level sequence features without alignment in recent preprints.

ranked.headline: Transcriptome-wide methods map RNA-protein binding and post-transcriptional regulation
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs large-scale RNA-binding and modification mapping with benchmarked long-read quantification and cross-species translational analyses.

ranked.headline: Population-scale eQTL methods expose cell-type and ancestry effects on gene regulation
ranked.summary: Population-scale expression data and new eQTL methods now allow regulatory effects to be benchmarked, simulated, and tested across ancestries.

ranked.headline: Network models link microbial interactions to drug and combination prioritization
ranked.summary: Microbiome-aware metabolic and network models are now being used to prioritize drug combinations and quantify microbial interaction balance.

ranked.headline: Coarse-grained models map binding and folding free energies for ligands and DNA
ranked.summary: Coarse-grained free energy methods are being assessed against binding and folding benchmarks in ligand and DNA systems.

ranked.headline: Deep learning predicts chromatin contacts and loops from protein binding profiles
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple binding profiles to predicted contact maps while correcting antibody background in cohesin ChIP-seq data.

ranked.headline: Reduced and agent-based models of multicellular fate, pattern and fixation dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair reduced equations and multiscale agent-based simulations with tumor, granuloma, lesion and bacterial population dynamics.

ranked.headline: Spatial, network and genetic structure shaping pathogen transmission inference
ranked.summary: Transmission models now encode mobility networks, spatio-temporal priors and viral haplotype similarity to forecast outbreaks.

ranked.headline: Computational pipelines extract molecular structure from MINFLUX, FRET, and cryo-EM data
ranked.summary: New computational pipelines target single-molecule, fluorescence, and cryo-EM data, adding uncertainty-aware and GPU-accelerated analysis.

ranked.headline: Computational models generate and score protein sequences, structures, and inhibitors
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair rule-based, language-model, and thermodynamic scoring frameworks with sequence and inhibitor design.

ranked.headline: Single-cell identity is encoded distributively across transcriptomes and spatial fields
ranked.summary: Malignant cell identity tracks patient tumor across 14 cancer types, motivating continuous per-cell identity models in scRNA-seq and Xenium data.

ranked.headline: Long-read assemblies of kelp, microsporidian symbiont and reef coral genomes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints report chromosome-scale assemblies for a kelp, a microsporidian symbiont and a reef coral, extending available genomic resources.

ranked.headline: Targeted long-read methylation profiling and radiation-induced genomic instability
ranked.summary: Locus-resolved methylation tools and dose-time genome-integrity frameworks are now being applied to biomarker discovery, epigenome editing, and irradiation.

ranked.headline: Accelerated simulation and automated selection analysis for sequencing and genomic data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints report 15-24x speedups for NGS read simulation and up to hundreds-fold gains for selection-sweep detection.
